So, $25x = 120$.

Since the number of people must be an integer, we can round to the nearest whole number. However, we are given that she has sold the books to $x$ people, so the number of people must be an integer.

She spent $5(4)=20$ dollars on the books to make.

If $x=5$, then she has sold 5 books and made $20(5)=100$ dollars from them.
She spent $5(5)=25$ dollars on the books to make.
So her profit is $100-25=75$ dollars.
